mapper.select: SELECT p.routing_node_id AS routingNodeId, COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta), 0) AS reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id = p.execution_id AND r.routing_node_id = p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_id = #{executionId} GROUP BY p.routing_node_id

SELECT r.id AS reportId, r.quantity_delta + COALESCE(SUM(a.quantity_delta), 0) AS effectiveQty FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id = e.id LEFT JOIN mes_production_report a ON a.reference_report_id = r.id AND a.execution_id = e.id AND a.routing_node_id = r.routing_node_id WHERE e.id = #{executionId} AND r.id = #{reportId} GROUP BY r.id, r.quantity_delta

SELECT e.id AS executionId,e.workorder_id AS workorderId,e.routing_id AS routingId, e.target_qty AS targetQty,p.path_status AS pathStatus, CASE WHEN e.routing_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) END AS lastNodeReportedQty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.output_qty) FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_id=f.execution_id WHERE f.execution_id=e.id AND f.input_kind=#{enumProductionInput} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode=#{enumLocalOnly} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status=#{enumPosted} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document_line original_line JOIN wm_stock_action reversal ON reversal.reference_action_id=original_line.stock_action_id WHERE original_line.document_id=f.document_id AND reversal.action_type=#{enumReversal})),0) AS productionInputQty FROM mes_production_execution e LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path p ON p.id=e.id LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path_node n ON n.execution_id=e.id AND n.sequence_no=(SELECT MAX(last.sequence_no) FROM mes_execution_path_node last WHERE last.execution_id=e.id) LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=e.id AND r.routing_node_id=n.routing_node_id WHERE e.workorder_id=#{workorderId} GROUP BY e.id,e.workorder_id,e.routing_id,e.target_qty,p.path_status ORDER BY e.id DESC
mapper.sql: FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_id=f.execution_id WHERE f.input_kind=#{enumProductionInput} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode=#{enumLocalOnly} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status=#{enumPosted} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document_line original_line JOIN wm_stock_action reversal ON reversal.reference_action_id=original_line.stock_action_id WHERE original_line.document_id=f.document_id AND reversal.action_type=#{enumReversal})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS confirmedQty, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS reservedQty AND f.execution_id=#{executionId}
SELECT f.execution_id AS executionId,COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS confirmedQty, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS reservedQty AND f.execution_id IN #{id} GROUP BY f.execution_id

SELECT p.execution_id executionId,p.routing_node_id routingNodeId,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=p.execution_id AND r.routing_node_id=p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_id IN #{id} GROUP BY p.execution_id,p.routing_node_id
